scenario: A semiconductor buyer compares two incoming-inspection pipelines across mature-node, specialty-node, and bleeding-edge suppliers. Procurement prefers Pipeline A because its aggregate defect-free acceptance rate is much higher.

data.description: Defect-free acceptance by supplier category and pipeline.

question: (a) Which pipeline performs better in each supplier category? (b) If the target sourcing mix is 25% mature-node, 35% specialty-node, and 40% bleeding-edge, compute the corrected acceptance rate for each pipeline. (c) Which pipeline should be preferred?

ground_truth.explanation: Pipeline B is stronger in all three supplier categories. Pipeline A's aggregate win reflects a much easier vendor mix.

naive_answer: Pipeline A should be preferred because its aggregate acceptance rate is higher.
naive_trap: The aggregate comparison hides category mix effects.
